FROM date_dim dt
JOIN store_sales ss ON dt.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk AND dt.d_moy = 11
JOIN item ON ss.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_manufact_id = 816
GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_brand, item.i_brand_id
ORDER BY dt.d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id
LIMIT 100
